question: Which sport's terminology includes "Queen's Gambit"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Queen's Gambit** is a popular term used in the game of **Chess**. It refers to a specific type of chess opening where the player sacrifices a pawn to gain control of the center of the board.
 
• The Queen's Gambit opening begins with the moves 1.d4 d5 2.c4, where the pawn on c4 is offered as a gambit.
 
• It is considered one of the oldest and most classical chess openings, dating back to the early 15th century.
 
• The Queen's Gambit is particularly effective for players who want to develop their pieces quickly and dominate the middle squares of the chessboard.
 
• This opening has been extensively studied and is favored by many grandmasters, including the legendary Bobby Fischer and Garry Kasparov.
